_metadata.description: Low-risk DNS filtering controls with preview and rollback.

requirements.title: DNS filtering changes are previewable and reversible
requirements.description: The scenario shall provide allowlist, denylist, blocklist, pause/resume, and policy preview controls that show intended resolver changes before apply and preserve a rollback path after apply.

validation.notes: Add service and UI tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-003] that verify preview, apply, pause/resume, and rollback records for fake resolver policies.
